title: Public feedback submission
description: The only place an anonymous visitor can send data. Server-side validation is authoritative; this schema documents the contract.

consent.description: Explicit checkbox. Submission is rejected without it.

turnstileToken.description: Only when CAPTCHA is configured; verified server-side.

company_website.description: Honeypot. Must be empty — a non-empty value means a bot filled a hidden field.
